idea-plugin.name: SSM Graph
idea-plugin.description:
Spring State Machine Visualizer

Streamline your development process by visualizing complex Spring State Machine configurations directly within your IDE. This plugin provides a clear, graphical representation of your state machine logic.

  • Interactive Graph Visualization: Automatically renders states and transitions into an intuitive visual map, making it easier to grasp complex business flows at a glance.
  • Advanced Toolset: Utilize a dedicated UI panel with specialized tools designed to enhance graph readability, allowing you to inspect, organize, and analyze your state machine structure more effectively.

Stop tracing transitions manually in your code and let the visualizer provide the clarity you need to debug and develop faster.
